svg.title: Shared cell measurements and alternative routes to phenotypes
svg.desc: Six selected cells form the rows of one saved measurement matrix. Marker Mean and Median columns can supply marker gates and combinations, distance-based unsupervised groups that are named, or a supervised classifier trained from labelled reference cells. Shape columns can also enter the supervised classifier. Separate marker-image and cell-mask inputs feed Nimbus marker scores into rules. Separate masked multichannel cell crops feed KRONOS embeddings into supervised classification. One selected route produces the shared phenotype assignment table, retaining cell IDs. Values, image patterns, groups and phenotype names are illustrative.
